1.20.1.2.0.0:
The Botanical Grimoire, the missing school assets, and Scroll Forge citizenship.

The Botanical Grimoire never opened: Patchouli 1.20 removed use_resource_pack: false and the book omitted the flag, which reads as false. The flag is set and the book's content has moved to assets/, which is the layout every Patchouli book that loads on 1.20.1 uses.

Botany scrolls and Botany affinity rings rendered as the purple-and-black missing-model cube. Iron's Spells registers item/scroll_<school> and item/affinity_ring_<school> for every school in the registry; this mod shipped neither, and no Item owns those paths, so nothing noticed. Both now ship, and the build fails if a registered school is ever missing one.

A Botany focus could not be placed in a Scroll Forge, because the slot filters on #irons_spellbooks:school_focus and the Botany focus tag was not a member - so no Botany scroll could be crafted at all. The three Mana Inks were rejected by the ink slot for the same class of reason: it filters on InkItem, and they were look-alike plain items. Both fixed; the inks now scribe at the Uncommon, Rare and Epic tiers their tooltips always claimed.

Also: nine scroll recipes declared irons_spellbooks:scroll_forge as a recipe type, which is a block id and not a recipe serializer, so they were rejected on every load and are removed; the Elementium Scroll's Elven Trade required a tag that does not exist; Botany kills printed a raw translation key; and getSpellPower/getSpellCooldown could throw on a client that had not loaded the config yet, which is exactly what scroll-description add-ons call.

Includes everything in 1.11.0.
1.20.1.1.11.0:
Client HUD, per-tick transfer fairness, and data hardening.

The mana HUD ran its full capability sweep about fifteen times per frame (the overlay event was never filtered to a single overlay), double-counted stacks that appear in both Botania lists, ignored the configured HUD scale, and did not clamp its fill. All fixed, plus a hudPulseNearby accessibility option for motion sensitivity.

Spell Reservoirs and Mana Conduits granted EACH nearby player a full transfer rate per tick, so the configured block rate was silently multiplied by the number of players standing nearby. There is now one budget per tick, divided fairly and rotated so nobody is permanently favoured.

Stored mana is clamped and computed in long throughout, so malformed NBT cannot report negative mana and a large top-up cannot wrap around to zero the item.

Includes everything in 1.10.0. BACK UP YOUR WORLD BEFORE UPGRADING. See docs/UPGRADING-1.10.0.md.
1.20.1.1.10.0:
Stability, compatibility and correctness release.

Fixes the crash when ISS-Scroll Descriptions or ISS-Restrictions inspect a Botany spell: the Botany school's display name had no colour, and Iron's Spells' SchoolType#getTargetingColor() dereferences that colour without a null check.

Rebuilds mana routing as a single per-cast transaction. A failed, cancelled or interrupted cast can no longer drain mana or consume catalysts, same-tick casts can no longer share payment state, and Botania payment now works for a player carrying a single mana item (it previously never could).

Every upgrade orb now applies its own attribute and returns its own item; rune-enhanced scrolls finally do something; Botany power, resistance and mana-efficiency attributes are attached to players and actually read.

BACK UP YOUR WORLD BEFORE UPGRADING. See docs/UPGRADING-1.10.0.md.
